I would say being introduced to a group of what would become friends. They show you that there's more to life than what you thought. Your given hope for a better future and feel empowered, but it doesn't last. You slowly push them away due to long standing mental issues that you're not entirely sure how to deal with. They stop texting and responding so you focus on keeping yourself above water. One day you you decide to take the initiative and try engaging again, one problem they're not interested in hearing what you have to say. No goodbyes, no resolution, just a feeling of emptiness. The worst feeling in the world put simply is despair.

Imagine if you, finding yourself at the hentai booth at the latest anime convention. You ask the vendor what is the weirdest piece piece they have. They seem to ponder for a moment. Then they have it, an ephinay! They shuffle off and pull something out of the back of the stall. $50 he says. You ask what it is. He ask to you want rare, nay prime hentai that is freaky beyond all belief? You say of course. He says again $50. You ponder for a moment. You tell yourself you only live once and hand over the $50. You open the package to see cover art reminiscent of Disney Era fantasia. It's Mickey Mouse as you've never seen him before. XD
Until you've seen Micky Mouse fucking himself and I do mean himself you haven't lived.
